description: Submit-time validation for a bulk leads import in the Svelte 5 data grid. Users edit freely, then click Submit and a row-level validator runs over the in-memory rows; invalid cells are highlighted through cellClass, every error is listed in an aria-live panel, and the payload only goes to the server when the error list is empty.

faq.question: How is this different from validating on each edit?
faq.answer: Nothing runs while the user types. Validation happens once on Submit against all rows, which suits imports where a row may be temporarily incomplete while it is being filled in.

faq.question: How are invalid cells highlighted?
faq.answer: The column's cellClass function reads the derived errors map and returns an error class for cells that failed, so the styling is data-driven and clears when the row passes.

faq.question: Why an aria-live panel for the errors?
faq.answer: So screen readers announce the error list when it changes. The panel lists each row and field with its message, and submission stays blocked until the list is empty.
